title_en: Psychology Made Simple (4/20): The Power of a Little Sticker
note_en: 小华越得到贴纸，就越愿意主动整理玩具 uses 越…越… for "the more... the more...": each 越 goes directly before a verb or adjective, and 就 often links the second half. English has to restructure the clauses ("The more stickers Xiaohua got, the more willing he was"), while Chinese keeps normal subject-verb order in both halves.
